main.name: Tobi Oladimeji
main.description: I build decision-intelligence products and work across data, AI, and analytics — five years in enterprise data before moving into founding companies.
main.availability: Open to senior data, AI & analytics roles
bio: I'm the founder of Inscend and Data Fellows, and I work across data, analytics, and applied AI.

Inscend is the decision layer for founder-led commerce — for beauty and retail brands, it turns everyday shop data into a short list of prioritized, ready-to-complete actions instead of another dashboard. Data Fellows is an applied data community and venture-building ecosystem with 1,500+ members across 15+ countries.

Before founding these, I spent 5+ years in enterprise data and analytics: enterprise data migration and reporting at PwC, analytics and ML workflows at ESGTree, and data quality and automation systems for Granted. I'm based in Waterloo Region, Ontario, and selected for the League of Innovators, Canada's accelerator for founders under 30.
main.contactmessage: Open to conversations about Inscend, Data Fellows, senior data/AI roles, partnerships, or interesting problems in decision intelligence.

resume.skillmessage: Core analytics, reporting, data, and automation capabilities.

work.title: Founder & CEO
highlights: Founded and grew a 1,500+ member data and technology ecosystem across 15+ countries.
Lead partnerships, learning programs, applied analytics initiatives, and cross-functional delivery of practical data and AI projects.
Incubated Inscend through product discovery, data strategy, and applied automation.

work.title: Strategic Advisor, Data & Operations
highlights: Advise on data architecture, quality controls, workflows, and automation for a grant-intelligence platform.
Develop QA frameworks supporting 1,500+ grant records and end-to-end discovery, validation, and structured extraction workflows.
Define operational KPIs, apply AI-assisted data cleaning, and translate findings into leadership reporting.

work.title: Data Analyst & Machine Learning Engineer
highlights: Built Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions to support environmental data insights and operational tracking.
Supported SQL and Python pipelines while collaborating with data engineers on scalable analytics workflows.
Developed LLM-based document extraction that reduced manual data input by approximately 30% across cross-functional workflows.

work.title: Data Analytics Team Lead
highlights: Supported an enterprise transition from Microsoft Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, achieving approximately 98% data accuracy.
Led 20 mapping and requirements sessions and collaborated with 15 stakeholders across the transformation.
Developed 30+ Python scripts and delivered SQL, Excel, Power BI, validation, transformation, and senior-management reporting.

work.title: Data Analyst
highlights: Developed 10+ Power BI dashboards and recurring operational reports using SQL and Excel.
Delivered Python analytics projects with pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
Improved database validation and automation processes, contributing to an approximately 25% improvement in data accuracy.

testimonials.text: It was a great pleasure to have worked with Tobi. He is a very responsible, determined, and hard working profesional. Tobi really helped us in analyzing data and report generation for various clients, developing them in PowerBi and integrating databases. Constantly solved problems and proposed new ideas. Tobi was always a team player and was invested in making things work. Apart from being a great profesional he is a great person.

Tobi's excepcional patience, professionalism, and capability to understand and work with disorganized data sets have turned him into an asset for our team. I admire his capacity to create reports from scratch in Power BI and connect various platforms to turn simple datasets added to a Google Sheets into meaningful reports for making informed decisions. Of course, he is a great coworker, and I can wholeheartedly recommend Tobi without any doubt.

Tobi is an outstanding young professional with so much potential. During our time at PwC, I witnessed his dedication to mastering data analysis. Tobi's ability to tackle complex data challenges and his eagerness to learn set him apart. He's not just a team player but also brings a fresh perspective to every project. I highly recommend Tobi for his skills, passion, and the promise he holds in the field of data analytics.

I wholeheartedly recommend Tobi for his exceptional contributions at Rollbackally. From the moment he joined our team, it was clear that he possessed a remarkable ability to adapt, coupled with a strong work ethic that consistently translated into outstanding results. Tobi's dedication to his work is truly commendable, and his talent shines through in all that he undertakes. He is not only a skilled professional but also a natural leader who knows how to guide the team effectively toward achieving our goals. I am confident that Tobi will continue to excel in any role he takes on in the future.
